about: References for the Studio: models, data sheets, lighting files, structures and papers. Every real object in a scene comes from an entry here. An entry with an unknown licence can be a candidate only. See POLICY.md.

entries.subject: 0.2 mL PCR tube with attached cap
entries.name: TEST TUBE 0,2 ml (generic test tube with attached lid, commonly used for PCR)
entries.note: STL fetched on 2026-11-01 with the owner's yes. 6,392 triangles. Bounding box 7.06 x 23.44 x 21.06 mm. The SPL data sheet gives 7.26 mm diameter and 20.80 mm height (without an open lid). Which axis is the tube length, and how far the open lid reaches, are not yet read from the mesh, so the check against the sheet is still open. A generic tube, not a named maker's. The terms of 3D ContentCentral were not read, so the licence stays unknown and the file is not used in a pitch until they are read.

entries.subject: 0.2 mL PCR tube
entries.name: pcr tube 0.2ml (by smhs sutaer, SOLIDWORKS 2017)
entries.note: Found in the GrabCAD list for the tag pcr; the model page has not been opened. The download needs an account and the licence is not stated in the list.

entries.subject: 0.2 mL PCR tube (maker: Thermo Fisher MicroAmp), no cap
entries.name: Thermo Fisher MicroAmp PCR tube - NO cap (May 2020)
entries.note: A named maker's tube body, without a cap. The model page has not been opened. The download needs an account.

entries.subject: 96-well PCR plate (wells of the same shape family as a PCR tube; not a single tube)
entries.name: PCR Plate | FREE 3d | Low poly (Naked Singularity Studio)
entries.note: 9,960 faces, 1.1 MB glb. The page label says CC Attribution; the version of the licence has not been read. It does not hold a single tube with a cap.

entries.subject: 0.2 mL PCR tube, single, flat cap (SPL #60001)
entries.name: SPL PCR Tube technical data sheet
entries.note: The whole PDF text was read. The drawing itself was not seen: it shows 5.82 and 28.3 without labels in the text. These numbers only check a 3D model; they are not the source of its shape.

entries.subject: Immunoglobulin G (whole mouse IgG2a antibody)
entries.name: PDB 1IGT
entries.note: The file is in the main Molecullage folder, data/pdb/1IGT.pdb. The longest axis is measured from the atom coordinates. The live mesh must stay close to the full surface; see POLICY.md.

entries.subject: Camel single-domain VH antibody fragment in complex with hen egg-white lysozyme
entries.name: PDB 1MEL
entries.note: The file is in the main Molecullage folder, data/pdb/1MEL.pdb, with contacts in motion/films/assets/contacts_1MEL.json.

entries.subject: Antibodies per gold nanoparticle
entries.name: Zhang L et al. Direct quantification of surface coverage of antibody in IgG-Gold nanoparticles conjugates. Talanta 204:875-881 (2019)
entries.note: Only the abstract was read; the journal text is behind a paywall and no open copy was found. The abstract claims about 4 IgG per 15 nm gold particle. Under the source policy this is ungrounded and no scene or slide may use it as evidence.

entries.subject: Antibody coverage and orientation on gold nanoparticles
entries.name: Zhang L et al. Antibody-Gold Nanoparticle Bioconjugates for Biosensors. Biosens Bioelectron 165:112370 (2020)
entries.note: Only the abstract was read. The open copy on HAL (hal-02928749) has the right cover page but its body is a different paper, on water evaporation (a deposit error). No usable full text was obtained. It is ungrounded.

entries.subject: Antibody gold conjugates in lateral flow tests
entries.name: Conrad M et al. Tools to compare antibody gold nanoparticle conjugates for a small molecule immunoassay. Mikrochim Acta 190:62 (2023)
entries.note: Full text read in PubMed Central. It states that direct coating gives randomly oriented antibodies on the gold surface. The coverage numbers are the authors' calculation from the antibody footprint, not measurements; the particles were 20 nm (direct coating) and 40 nm (streptavidin gold).

entries.subject: Crystal structure of camel single-domain VH antibody fragment in complex with lysozyme (PDB 1MEL)
entries.name: Desmyter A et al. Crystal structure of a camel single-domain VH antibody fragment in complex with lysozyme. Nat Struct Biol 3:803-811 (1996)
entries.note: Metadata verified via Crossref; structural coordinates and 55 contact residue pairs within 4.5 A are read directly from primary data file data/pdb/1MEL.pdb (entry structure-pdb-1mel).

entries.subject: Rapid on-site nucleic acid extraction and RPA lateral-flow detection from plants
entries.name: Ma Q et al. SMART: On-Site Rapid Detection of Nucleic Acid from Plants, Animals, and Microorganisms in under 25 Minutes. Biosensors 13(1):82 (2023)
entries.note: Verified via Crossref on 2026-11-09 for Miraeles field extraction and amplification workflow.

entries.subject: Rapid field detection of plant fungal pathogen DNA
entries.name: Peng J et al. A simple and rapid method for wheat blast detection in the field. Phytopathol Res 8:14 (2026)
entries.note: Verified via Crossref on 2026-11-09 for field plant fungal nucleic-acid assay timing and workflow.

entries.subject: Nucleic acid lateral flow strip with anti-FAM gold conjugate and streptavidin/anti-antibody capture lines
entries.name: Akalin E et al. Development of a nucleic acid-based lateral flow device as a reliable diagnostic tool for respiratory viral infections. MethodsX 11:102372 (2023)
entries.note: Verified via Crossref on 2026-11-09 for standard dual-tag (FAM/biotin) nucleic acid lateral-flow strip architecture.

entries.subject: RPA isothermal amplification paired with lateral-flow readout
entries.name: Liu H et al. RPA-Cas12a-FS: A frontline nucleic acid rapid detection system for food safety based on CRISPR-Cas12a combined with recombinase polymerase amplification. Food Chem 338:127608 (2021)
entries.note: Verified via Crossref on 2026-11-09 for recombinase polymerase amplification reaction window and lateral-flow strip readout.

entries.subject: Scaled dot-product multi-head attention
entries.name: Vaswani A et al. Attention Is All You Need. arXiv:1706.03762 (2017)
entries.note: Verified via DataCite on 2026-11-09 for quadratic attention activation scaling over sequence length.

entries.subject: Rectified straight-line transport path between noise and data
entries.name: Liu X, Gong C, Liu Q. Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow. arXiv:2209.03003 (2022)
entries.note: Verified via DataCite on 2026-11-09 for linear interpolation path x_t = (1-t)*x_0 + t*x_1 and velocity target x_1 - x_0.

entries.subject: Flow matching continuous-time generative training
entries.name: Lipman Y et al. Flow Matching for Generative Modeling. arXiv:2210.02747 (2022)
entries.note: Verified via DataCite on 2026-11-09 for flow-matching conditional vector field training.

entries.subject: Adam first- and second-moment optimizer state
entries.name: Kingma DP, Ba J. Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization. arXiv:1412.6980 (2014)
entries.note: Verified via DataCite on 2026-11-09 for two fp32 moment buffers alongside fp32 master weights and gradients (16 bytes per parameter).

entries.subject: Latent-variable encoder-decoder representation learning
entries.name: Kingma DP, Welling M. Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes. arXiv:1312.6114 (2013)
entries.note: Verified via DataCite on 2026-11-09 for encoder-bottleneck-decoder architecture background.

searches.result: No single PCR tube with a cap. Found a PCR plate (CC-BY), holders and machines. A Sketchfab download needs an account.

searches.query: 0.2 mL PCR tube 3D model with cap
searches.result: Only racks, rotors and openers. No accurate single tube with a cap that downloads without an account.
